_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: main, feat(tenor) — the nineteenth pack and its kit, 2026-08-14, clean tree (no nested worktree)
_raised: validate.py 2179 -> 2294, validate_palette.py 1095 -> 1156, sloplint.py 464 -> 478: the `tenor` pack and kit arrived in 1.29.0, and two reciprocal forks were added to `blueprint` and `roster`. Purely additive, and the same shape as the 1.28.0 raise: a nineteenth pack adds its structural, contract, enumeration, link and kit checks, two declaration blocks of solid tokens with their peer separations and status-on-field ratios, and one more pack plus one more kit stylesheet to the slop lint. No check was removed or weakened and all three self-tests still catch every planted defect. validate.py 2067 -> 2179, validate_palette.py 1001 -> 1095, sloplint.py 450 -> 464: the `ora` pack and kit arrived in 1.28.0. Purely additive — an eighteenth pack adds its structural, contract, enumeration, link and kit checks to validate.py; two themes of solid tokens with their peer separations and status-on-field ratios to validate_palette.py; and one more pack plus one more kit stylesheet to the slop lint. No check was removed or weakened, and all three self-tests still catch every planted defect. The previous entry is kept below because it explains what the validate.py number means: both ROOT markdown walks skip nested checkouts, so the count no longer moves with whether a worktree happens to exist. validate_palette.py 993 -> 1001: editorial-luxury's status set arrived in 1.25.0 from a concurrent run -- eight semantic colours, each measured against the field of its own theme by the check below. Additive with nothing else: 958 base + 8 theirs + 35 mine. validate.py holds at 2067, but the number means something it did not mean before: both ROOT markdown walks now skip nested checkouts, so the count no longer moves with whether a worktree happens to exist. It did move -- 2361 with one present against 2067 clean on the same commit, and 2361 was the number this file was about to enshrine. The plant for it is the only one whose pass condition is silence: a nested checkout must change neither verdict nor count. validate_palette.py 958 -> 993: validate_status_on_field() checks every semantic colour against the field of its own theme, which nothing did before -- validate_theme() computed one contrast, ink against field, and went straight to peer separation. On its first run it found 28 findings in 11 of 17 packs, and the worst was mechanical: scoreboard's [data-surface="panel"] block remapped eleven tokens and not the status set, so var(--good) painted 3.69:1 on the dark band while --good-on-dark had 10.21 three lines away. Two plants, one per tier. validate.py and sloplint.py are unchanged at 2066 and 450. validate.py 2066 -> 2067: SURFACE_COMPOSITION.md documents the new role marker, which adds one relative-link check.
